dataset.label: MEPS HC-256: 2024 Full Year Consolidated Data File

cohort.label: Operational current Long COVID, adults 18-64, MEPS 2024
rule: Require AGE24X 18-64 and positive relevant survey weight.
Long COVID history is established by any valid LCEVER31/LCEVER53 Yes (1); prior Yes is not erased by a later No because AHRQ preserves prior Yes responses for eligible respondents.
Among history-positive persons, current status uses the latest valid COVSYMNOW response: COVSYMNOW53 if 1/2, otherwise COVSYMNOW31 if 1/2.
Current Long COVID case = documented Long COVID history plus latest valid current-symptom response Yes (1).
History-positive plus latest valid current-symptom No (2) = non-current.
No valid Long COVID history = unknown unless at least one valid LCEVER response is No and neither round is Yes; COVSYMNOW alone never creates a case.
All negative reserved codes remain missing/unknown and are never converted to No.
Conflicting history values (earlier Yes/later No) retain history-positive status and are flagged for diagnostics.
cohort.wording_caveat: COVSYMNOW asks whether the person has COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now. The artifact therefore describes an operational current-Long-COVID cohort: respondents with documented Long COVID history whose latest valid current-symptom assessment is Yes.

design.method: Taylor series linearization, with-replacement MEPS design
design.joint_weight_use: Not used in current pipeline; only for future analyses that jointly use PSAQ and ESAQ variables.
design.subpopulation_method: Create the full weight-specific survey design first, then use survey-domain/subpopulation estimation; do not pre-filter the raw file to the Long COVID cohort.
design.lonely_psu_policy: R survey options survey.lonely.psu='adjust' and survey.adjust.domain.lonely=TRUE; record this software policy in artifact provenance.
design.ci_method: 95% t-based confidence interval using survey design degrees of freedom for totals/means/proportions.
design.missingness: MEPS negative reserved codes are NA for analytical outcomes unless a code is a substantive category explicitly retained. Missing outcome responses are not coerced to zero.

measures.analytical_transformation: Filter 18 <= AGE24X <= 64
measures.interpretation: Defines reference age range; not an outcome.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not infer age at PSAQ/ESAQ administration from AGE24X alone.

measures.conceptual_measure: Ever had COVID-19 symptoms lasting >=3 months, Round 3/1
measures.universe: Adults for whom Long COVID item is applicable
measures.missing_reserved_values: negative reserved codes including -8 Don't Know, -7 Refused, -1 Inapplicable
measures.denominator: Adults 18-64 with valid Long COVID history classification
measures.analytical_transformation: Preserve Yes as history; never coerce reserved values to No
measures.interpretation: Part of cohort construction.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Not a current-symptom measure by itself.

measures.universe: Adults for whom Long COVID item is applicable

measures.denominator: Adults 18-64 with valid Long COVID history classification
measures.analytical_transformation: Any valid Yes establishes history; AHRQ preserves prior Yes responses for eligible respondents
measures.interpretation: Part of cohort construction.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: A later No cannot erase an earlier documented Yes; conflicting histories are flagged.

measures.conceptual_measure: Has COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now, Round 3/1

measures.analytical_transformation: Used only when no valid later COVSYMNOW53 response exists
measures.interpretation: Fallback current-status assessment.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Cannot establish Long COVID history by itself.

measures.conceptual_measure: Has COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now, Round 5/3
measures.universe: Persons reporting Long COVID in current or prior round
measures.missing_reserved_values: negative reserved codes including -8 Don't Know, -7 Refused, -1 Inapplicable
measures.denominator: Long COVID-history-positive adults with valid current-symptom response
measures.analytical_transformation: Latest valid assessment; supersedes COVSYMNOW31 for current status
measures.interpretation: Primary current-status assessment.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Wording is COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms now; interpret only conditional on documented Long COVID history.

measures.conceptual_measure: Reduced ability from COVID-19 or Long COVID-19 symptoms, Round 3/1

measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not use as a proxy for current Long COVID if history/current-symptom classification is unavailable.

measures.conceptual_measure: Annualized hours on own medical visits / filling prescriptions
measures.denominator: Current Long COVID adults 18-64 who responded to ESAQ and have valid EQMVAM53

measures.interpretation: Annualized time spent on own medical visits/filling prescriptions among valid ESAQ respondents.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Not diagnostic-delay time; do not sum with other ESAQ time domains.

measures.conceptual_measure: Annualized hours paying/managing medical bills or insurance

measures.analytical_transformation: Survey mean; AHRQ top-codes at 720
measures.interpretation: Annualized bills/insurance-management time among valid ESAQ respondents.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not sum into a diagnostic-burden score.

measures.conceptual_measure: Annualized hours on health care paperwork / finding doctors / plan information / approvals
measures.denominator: Current Long COVID adults 18-64 who responded to ESAQ and have valid EQPPAM53
measures.analytical_transformation: Survey mean; AHRQ top-codes at 520

measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not sum into a diagnostic-burden score.

measures.conceptual_measure: Health insurance denied/delayed prior approval before service/treatment/visit/drug
measures.valid_values: 1 Yes; 2 No; 3 never insured in past year; 4 not applicable/have not used services
measures.denominator: Current Long COVID adults 18-64 with ESAQ data and substantive yes/no response (1 or 2)
measures.analytical_transformation: Binary 1 for code 1 and 0 for code 2; exclude codes 3/4 and reserved from proportion denominator
measures.interpretation: Share of the exact yes/no-response universe reporting denial/delay.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Do not label as percent of all Long COVID patients or as diagnosis-related prior authorization.

measures.denominator: Current Long COVID adults 18-64 with PSAQ data and valid K6SUM42

measures.interpretation: Nonspecific psychological distress score distribution in cohort.
measures.prohibited_interpretation: Not psychiatric diagnosis; do not monetize or claim Long COVID/diagnostic delay caused distress.
